title: UK-Iranian dual national arrested over RAF Fairford incident, police say
description: The 27-year-old man was arrested in Westminster, London, the force said.

title: Hundreds of criminals start leaving prison under new early release scheme
description: Around 4,500 inmates are expected to be released early by June 2027 under a scheme designed to stop prisons becoming full.

title: Netanyahu says Flydubai flight attacker 'underwent Islamist radical indoctrination'
description: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

title: Man City to argue sponsorship deals came from Abu Dhabi government
description: Manchester City's appeal against the Premier League's verdict hinges on the club's claim that its sponsorship deals came from the Abu Dhabi government.

title: Burnham's Man City comments 'completely out of touch', Tories say
description: The prime minister said he would be "really concerned" if the club's owners sell up after Premier League rule breaches.

title: Tennessee halts executions after Christa Pike survives two lethal injection attempts
description: Pike had been on death row since she was convicted in 1996 for the murder of Colleen Slemmer.

title: Travelodge failed sex assault victim 'at every stage', review finds
description: Room intrusions were still being reported at one-in-10 Travelodge hotels this summer, a review finds.

title: Russia targets busy bridge in central Kyiv
description: The Pivdennyi bridge came under fire as a metro train was travelling across - the first such attack on Kyiv's bridges.

title: Flydubai passenger describes hugging his children as plane nosedived during attack
description: Adam Polovincik tells the BBC he told his young children "everything is going to be all right" as flight plunged more than 17,000ft (5,200m).
